name: Afragola (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Afragola (a hand holding strawberries on yellow) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Afragola, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Afragola arms — hand holding strawberries on yellow, crowned, within branches
